"Low byte of reg 25 (packet[54]). Reports the BMS operating mode and active-state flags as a single byte code. The high bit (0x80) distinguishes Active from Inactive states. Inactive codes (BMS output FETs may be open or limited): 0x00=Inactive/Standby (idle, no charge or discharge), 0x01=Inactive/Charging (charge FET open, accepting charge), 0x02=Inactive/Discharging (discharge FET open, supplying load), 0x04=Inactive/Protect (FETs held open by a protection condition â check regs 26-28), 0x08=Inactive/Charging_Lmt (current-limited charge; BMS throttling input). Active codes (BMS FETs closed, normal operation): 0x80=Active/Standby (FETs closed but no significant current flow), 0x81=Active/Charging (normal charge in progress), 0x82=Active/Discharging (normal discharge in progress), 0x84=Active/Protect (transient protect condition; FETs may momentarily open), 0x88=Active/Charging_Lmt (FETs closed but charge current is being actively limited by BMS). Any value not listed above should be treated as unknown/reserved."

High byte of reg 25 (packet[53]). Reports the state of the internal battery heater circuit used to warm cells in sub-zero ambient conditions so that charging is safe (lithium cells must not be charged below 0 Â°C). 0x80=Heater ON â the BMS has activated the heating element; charging may be deferred or reduced until cell temperatures rise above the charge_ut_protect threshold (reg 91). 0x00=Heater OFF â cells are at or above the minimum charge temperature; heater is not energized. No other values are defined. Monitor in conjunction with temp_sensor_1..4 (regs 33-34) and charge_ut_warn/protect/release (regs 90-92) to understand thermal management behavior.
Reg 26 bit 0. Early warning: pack (string) voltage has risen above the over-voltage warning threshold. 1=Pack_OV active, 0=clear. Does not trigger protection; alerts before protection_pack_ov fires.
Reg 26 bit 1. Early warning: one or more individual cell voltages exceed the cell over-voltage warning threshold. 1=Cell_OV active, 0=clear. Precursor to protection_cell_ov.
Reg 26 bit 10. Early warning: battery temperature during charging has dropped below the under-temperature warning threshold (UT = Under Temperature). 1=Charge_UT active, 0=clear.
Reg 26 bit 11. Early warning: battery temperature during discharging has dropped below the under-temperature warning threshold. 1=Discharge_UT active, 0=clear.
Reg 26 bit 12. Early warning: state-of-charge (SOC) has dropped below the low-capacity warning threshold. 1=Low_Capacity active, 0=clear. Alerts before full discharge protection triggers.
Reg 26 bit 13. Warning: float charging has been suspended or interrupted before completion. 1=Float_Stopped active, 0=clear. Indicates the charger did not complete the float-charge phase.
Reg 26 bit 14. Warning: BMS has entered an inactive/protected state (e.g. over-discharge lockout or external protect signal). 1=Inactive/Protect active, 0=clear.
Reg 26 bit 15. Warning: BMS is inactive and charge current is being limited (throttled below the configured maximum). 1=Inactive/Charging_Lmt active, 0=clear.
Reg 26 bit 2. Early warning: pack (string) voltage has dropped below the under-voltage warning threshold. 1=Pack_UV active, 0=clear. Precursor to protection_pack_uv.
Reg 26 bit 3. Early warning: one or more individual cell voltages have dropped below the cell under-voltage warning threshold. 1=Cell_UV active, 0=clear. Precursor to protection_cell_uv.
Reg 26 bit 4. Early warning: charge current has exceeded the over-current warning threshold. 1=Charge_OC active, 0=clear. Precursor to protection_charge_oc.
Reg 26 bit 5. Early warning: discharge current has exceeded the over-current warning threshold. 1=Discharge_OC active, 0=clear. Precursor to protection_discharge_oc.
Reg 26 bit 6. Early warning: ambient (environmental) temperature sensor reading is outside the normal operating range (too hot or too cold). 1=Abnormal_Ambient_Temp active, 0=clear.
Reg 26 bit 7. Early warning: MOSFET (charge/discharge switch) temperature has exceeded the overheat warning threshold. 1=MOS_Overheating active, 0=clear. Precursor to protection_mos_overheat.
Reg 26 bit 8. Early warning: battery temperature during charging has exceeded the over-temperature warning threshold (OT = Over Temperature). 1=Charge_OT active, 0=clear.
Reg 26 bit 9. Early warning: battery temperature during discharging has exceeded the over-temperature warning threshold. 1=Discharge_OT active, 0=clear.

Reg 27 bit 0. Hard protection: pack (string) voltage exceeded the over-voltage protection limit. BMS opens charge FET to halt charging. 1=Pack_OV tripped, 0=clear. Latches until voltage drops below release threshold.
Reg 27 bit 1. Hard protection: one or more cell voltages exceeded the cell over-voltage protection limit. BMS opens charge FET. 1=Cell_OV tripped, 0=clear.

Reg 27 bit 10. Hard protection: battery temperature during charging dropped below the under-temperature protection limit. BMS opens charge FET to prevent lithium plating. 1=Charge_UT tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 11. Hard protection: battery temperature during discharging dropped below the under-temperature protection limit. BMS opens discharge FET. 1=Discharge_UT tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 12. Hard protection: SOC has reached the configured low-capacity protection floor. BMS opens discharge FET to prevent deep discharge. 1=Low_Capacity tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 13. Hard protection: float-charge phase was stopped by the BMS (e.g. timeout or fault during absorption/float). 1=Float_Stopped tripped, 0=clear.

Reg 27 bit 14. Hard protection: BMS is in an inactive/protect state â FETs are held open due to a protection condition. 1=Inactive/Protect active, 0=clear. Mirrors warning_inactive_protect at the protection severity level.

Reg 27 bit 15. Hard protection: BMS is inactive and charge current is being hard-limited. 1=Inactive/Charging_Lmt active, 0=clear. More severe than the corresponding warning bit; BMS enforces current cap.
Reg 27 bit 2. Hard protection: pack voltage dropped below the under-voltage protection limit. BMS opens discharge FET to halt load. 1=Pack_UV tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 3. Hard protection: one or more cell voltages dropped below the cell under-voltage protection limit. BMS opens discharge FET. 1=Cell_UV tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 4. Hard protection: charge current exceeded the over-current protection threshold. BMS opens charge FET. 1=Charge_OC tripped, 0=clear. See reg 78 for release timer.
Reg 27 bit 5. Hard protection: discharge current exceeded the over-current protection threshold. BMS opens discharge FET. 1=Discharge_OC tripped, 0=clear. See reg 79 for release timer.
Reg 27 bit 6. Hard protection: ambient temperature sensor reading exceeded safe operating bounds. BMS may limit or cut charging/discharging. 1=Abnormal_Ambient_Temp tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 7. Hard protection: MOSFET temperature exceeded the overheat protection threshold. BMS opens FETs to protect switching hardware. 1=MOS_Overheating tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 8. Hard protection: battery temperature during charging exceeded the over-temperature protection limit. BMS opens charge FET. 1=Charge_OT tripped, 0=clear.
Reg 27 bit 9. Hard protection: battery temperature during discharging exceeded the over-temperature protection limit. BMS opens discharge FET. 1=Discharge_OT tripped, 0=clear.

Reg 28 bit 0. Fault: a voltage measurement error has been detected by the BMS (e.g. ADC fault, sensor out of range, or pack voltage reading is implausible). 1=Voltage_Error active, 0=clear. Requires BMS inspection.

Reg 28 bit 1. Fault: a temperature sensor error has been detected (e.g. open/short thermistor, reading out of physical range). 1=Temperature_Error active, 0=clear. Affects thermal protection reliability.

Reg 28 bit 2. Fault: a current measurement error has been detected (e.g. shunt/hall-sensor fault, reading implausible). 1=Current_Flow_Error active, 0=clear. May disable charge/discharge current protection.

Reg 28 bit 4. Fault: cell voltages within the pack are significantly unbalanced beyond the allowable delta. 1=Cell_Unbalance active, 0=clear. BMS may activate passive balancing or restrict charging to top-balance cells.
